mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (title, content, reward_point) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{rewardPoint})

INSERT INTO mission_image (mission_id, origin_name, saved_name, file_path) VALUES
(#{image.missionId}, #{image.originName}, #{image.savedName}, #{image.filePath})
INSERT INTO user_mission (user_id, mission_id, completed) SELECT #{userId}, mission_id, 0 FROM mission;
mapper.select: SELECT um.user_mission_id AS userMissionId, um.user_id AS userId, um.mission_id AS missionId, um.completed, m.title, m.reward_point AS rewardPoint FROM user_mission um JOIN mission m ON um.mission_id = m.mission_id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission_post (user_mission_id, title, content, created_at) VALUES (#{userMissionId}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW())
